value.sql: SELECT date_format(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Closed Cases`, SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' AND `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Overturned Cases`, ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' AND `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 END, 2) AS `Overturn Rate` FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final` WHERE `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` >= '2025-08-01' AND `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` <= '2026-07-13' GROUP BY date_format(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY date_format(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, 'yyyy-MM') ASC
value.intent: Returns monthly overturn rate trend for closed cases between 2025-08-01 and 2026-07-13.

value.sql:
WITH avg_tat AS (
  SELECT
    `Provider_ID`,
    `Provider_Name`,
    date_format(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`,
    AVG(datediff(`Closed Date (CaseHistory)`, `Received Date`)) AS `Avg_TAT`
  FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final`
  WHERE `Case Status` = 'CLOSED'
    AND `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` >= '2026-05-01'
    AND `Closed Date (CaseHistory)` <= '2026-07-31'
  GROUP BY `Provider_ID`, `Provider_Name`, `Month`
),
month1 AS (
  SELECT `Provider_ID`, `Provider_Name`, `Avg_TAT` AS `Avg_TAT_Month1`
  FROM avg_tat
  WHERE `Month` = '2026-05'
),
month3 AS (
  SELECT `Provider_ID`, `Avg_TAT` AS `Avg_TAT_Month3`
  FROM avg_tat
  WHERE `Month` = '2026-07'
)
SELECT
  m1.`Provider_ID`,
  m1.`Provider_Name`,
  m1.`Avg_TAT_Month1`,
  m3.`Avg_TAT_Month3`,
  (m3.`Avg_TAT_Month3` - m1.`Avg_TAT_Month1`) AS `TAT_Increase`
FROM month1 m1
JOIN month3 m3 ON m1.`Provider_ID` = m3.`Provider_ID`
WHERE m3.`Avg_TAT_Month3` > m1.`Avg_TAT_Month1`
ORDER BY `TAT_Increase` DESC, `Provider_ID`
value.intent: Returns providers whose average turnaround time increased from May to July 2026.
